subproblem.title: Stability of weak equations under locally uniform convergence (limit equation of the blow-up)
subproblem.statement: Let n, l be natural numbers. Notation: L := L(R^n, R^l), the continuous linear maps R^n -> R^l with the operator norm; L* := continuous linear forms on L; Bil := continuous bilinear forms on L, viewed as continuous linear maps L -> L*, written b[P][Q]. B_r(0) is the open and Bbar_r(0) the closed ball; D denotes the Frechet derivative (fderiv); 'C^1_c map' means a C^1 map zeta : R^n -> R^l with compact support; integrals are Bochner integrals for Lebesgue measure. Let alpha >= 0 be real, A in Bil, ah_k : R^n -> Bil, Psi_k : R^n -> L*, U_k : R^n -> L (k in N), V : R^n -> L, and real sequences R_k, c_k, d_k. Assume: R_k -> +infinity, c_k -> 0 and d_k -> 0; V is continuous; for every real r, U_k -> V uniformly on Bbar_r(0); for every k, the map (z, P, Q) -> ah_k(z)[P][Q] is continuous on B_{R_k}(0) x L x L, and Psi_k and U_k are continuous on B_{R_k}(0); for all k, all z in B_{R_k}(0) and all P, Q in L: |ah_k(z)[P][Q] - A[P][Q]| <= c_k (1 + |z|^alpha) ||P|| ||Q|| and |Psi_k(z)[Q]| <= d_k |z|^alpha ||Q||; and for every k and every C^1_c map zeta with tsupport zeta contained in B_{R_k}(0), the integral over B_{R_k}(0) of ah_k(z)[U_k(z)][Dzeta(z)] equals the integral over B_{R_k}(0) of Psi_k(z)[Dzeta(z)]. Then the integral over R^n of A[V(z)][Dzeta(z)] is 0 for every C^1_c map zeta : R^n -> R^l.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (A : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (ah : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Ψ : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (U : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (V : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (R c d : ℕ → ℝ), 0 ≤ α → Tendsto R atTop atTop → Tendsto c atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto d atTop (𝓝 0) → Continuous V → (∀ r : ℝ, TendstoUniformlyOn U V atTop (closedBall (0 : Rn n) r)) → (∀ k, ContinuousOn (fun p : Rn n × (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) × (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) => ah k p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) (ball (0 : Rn n) (R k) ×ˢ univ)) → (∀ k, ContinuousOn (Ψ k) (ball (0 : Rn n) (R k))) → (∀ k, ContinuousOn (U k) (ball (0 : Rn n) (R k))) → (∀ k, ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |ah k z P Q - A P Q| ≤ c k * (1 + ‖z‖ ^ α) * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ k, ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ∀ Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |Ψ k z Q| ≤ d k * ‖z‖ ^ α * ‖Q‖) → (∀ k, ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k) → ∫ z in ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ah k z (U k z) (fderiv ℝ ζ z) = ∫ z in ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), Ψ k z (fderiv ℝ ζ z)) → ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ z, A (V z) (fderiv ℝ ζ z) = 0
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 8 of the parent proof, stated for general sequences. There ah_k = a_k(x_k + rho_k .), U_k = DW_k, V = DW, and the frozen coefficients A_k are merged into the constant c_k.
1. Fix a C^1_c map zeta and let T := tsupport zeta, which is compact.
 a. Choose r >= 1 with T contained in Bbar_r(0); compact sets are bounded.
 b. Let Z := sup over z in R^n of ||Dzeta(z)||. It is finite because Dzeta is continuous and vanishes outside T (support_fderiv_subset), so its norm attains a maximum on the compact set T.
 c. Let mu_r be the (finite) Lebesgue measure of Bbar_r(0), and N := sup over Bbar_r(0) of ||V||, finite since V is continuous on a compact set.
 d. Let C_A >= 0 satisfy |A[P][Q]| <= C_A ||P|| ||Q|| for all P, Q; it exists because A is a continuous bilinear map (for example its operator norm, ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm₂).
2. Choose k0 with R_k > r for all k >= k0. For such k, Bbar_r(0) and T are contained in B_{R_k}(0).
3. Integrands. For k >= k0 put F_k(z) := ah_k(z)[U_k(z)][Dzeta(z)] and E_k(z) := Psi_k(z)[Dzeta(z)], and put F(z) := A[V(z)][Dzeta(z)].
 a. All three vanish outside T, since they are linear in Dzeta(z).
 b. F_k is continuous on the open ball B_{R_k}(0): compose the joint continuity of (z, P, Q) -> ah_k(z)[P][Q] with z -> (z, U_k(z), Dzeta(z)). E_k is continuous there by continuity of Psi_k and of evaluation L* x L -> R. F is continuous on R^n because A is continuous bilinear and V, Dzeta are continuous.
 c. Let a function be continuous on an open set O and vanish outside a compact set T contained in O. Then it is continuous on all of R^n, since every point outside O has a neighbourhood disjoint from the closed set T. It also has compact support, so it is integrable, and its integral over O equals its integral over R^n (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero).
 d. Hence, for k >= k0, the hypothesis gives integral of F_k = integral of E_k over R^n. All integrals below may be computed over Bbar_r(0).
4. Error term. For k >= k0 and z in Bbar_r(0): |E_k(z)| <= |d_k| |z|^alpha ||Dzeta(z)|| <= |d_k| r^alpha Z. This uses |z|^alpha <= r^alpha for 0 <= |z| <= r and alpha >= 0; if alpha = 0 both sides are 1. Since E_k vanishes outside Bbar_r(0), |integral of E_k| <= |d_k| r^alpha Z mu_r -> 0.
5. Main term. Let k >= k0 and z in Bbar_r(0), and write P := U_k(z), Q := Dzeta(z).
 a. F_k(z) - F(z) = (ah_k(z)[P][Q] - A[P][Q]) + A[P - V(z)][Q]. Hence |F_k(z) - F(z)| <= |c_k| (1 + r^alpha) ||U_k(z)|| Z + C_A ||U_k(z) - V(z)|| Z.
 b. Let s_k := sup over Bbar_r(0) of ||U_k - V||. Then s_k -> 0 by uniform convergence on Bbar_r(0), and ||U_k(z)|| <= N + s_k there.
 c. So sup over Bbar_r(0) of |F_k - F| <= tau_k := Z (|c_k| (1 + r^alpha) (N + s_k) + C_A s_k), and tau_k -> 0.
 d. F_k - F vanishes outside Bbar_r(0), so |integral of F_k - integral of F| <= tau_k mu_r -> 0.
6. Conclusion. integral of F = lim of integral of F_k = lim of integral of E_k = 0, by steps 3, 4 and 5. Since zeta was arbitrary, the claim holds. QED.
Lean note: a norm on the bilinear-form type needs `set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3`. Alternatively, bound |A[P][Q]| through ||A P|| ||Q||.
proof_key_steps: fix zeta; choose r with tsupport zeta in Bbar_r(0); constants Z = sup ||Dzeta||, N = sup_{Bbar_r} ||V||, C_A
for k large, Bbar_r(0) lies in B_{R_k}(0); the integrands are continuous with compact support, so all integrals live on Bbar_r(0)
error term: |Psi_k[Dzeta]| <= |d_k| r^alpha Z, so its integral tends to 0
main term: |ah_k[U_k][Dzeta] - A[V][Dzeta]| <= Z(|c_k|(1 + r^alpha)(N + s_k) + C_A s_k) uniformly on Bbar_r(0), so the integrals converge
the integral of A[V][Dzeta] equals the limit of the error integrals, which is 0

audit.reason: All hypotheses and quantifiers match. On sufficiently large domains, continuity and compact support justify every integral manipulation. The explicit uniform bounds force the error integrals to zero and the principal integrals to the claimed limit. Absolute values handle unrestricted signs of c_k and d_k; alpha = 0 is covered. No circular dependency occurs.
